cards.name: llama.cpp (CPU fallback)
cards.hint: Always-on CPU fallback (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE) behind model-gateway's local-chat failover. Backend-only. Run: docker compose --profile cpu-fallback up -d llamacpp-cpu
cards.notes: Separate compose service from the GPU llamacpp — local-chat's failover target while the scheduler leases the 5090 to a render. Down = profile not running (expected on renders without the plugin).
